​As a wandering knight who chooses peace, I must ask. What peace is it? The peace of freedom, where no man lives in chains, or the peace of our homes, where our loved ones live without fear?

Perhaps it is both. For a wanderer does not fight because he loves war, but because he cherishes what lies beyond it.

Perhaps... this is what we fought for.

The world no longer needs this old knight.

My sword has served its purpose. My watch has come to an end.

May those who come after us inherit a gentler age.

And may the future... rest in the hands of God.

Now, let me rest.
